summary.headline: Muthoot Capital Q4 FY26 GNPA rose to 6.96% (interest accrual) on a single INR15.5 crore corporate NPA; management guides ~INR3,000 crore disbursements and INR400 crore equity raise.
summary.overview: Management reported AUM of INR3,441 crore at March 2026 (INR3,500 crore including managed book), with the MCSL-own book up to INR2,758 crore from INR2,118 crore while co-lending ran down to INR595 crore from INR940 crore. Reported GNPA rose to 6.96% (interest accrual) and 6.41% (principal), driven mainly by a single corporate loan (Up Money, INR15.51 crore) classified as NPA in March; management said the retail flow-forward fell to 0.43% from 0.80% at the start of the year. Full-year impairment was INR76 crore versus INR18-18.5 crore in FY25, and cost-to-income is about 85% for now, with management guiding 70-75% for the full year. Management confirmed a DA transaction of about INR100 crore with Hinduja, and cost of funds fell to 9.48% in Q4 from 10.09% in Q3. Questions focused on the lack of profitability and dividends, the NPA trajectory, and the lack of disbursement growth; management pointed to a 2-wheeler-funded cost base, and a shift away from co-lending.

segments.name: 2-wheeler
segments.commentary: Core book and main profit contributor; yield 22.02%. Management says it is currently funding the CV and used-car verticals, and 2-wheeler credit is now largely scorecard-automated.

segments.name: Used car (4-wheeler)
segments.commentary: AUM rose to INR155 crore from INR86 crore at start of year; yield 18.45%. Management expects breakeven in FY27 but has not included it in ROA targets.

segments.name: Commercial vehicles
segments.commentary: AUM rose to about INR240 crore from INR61.25 crore at start of year; yield 7.31%. Underwriting is still manual with digital flow; management expects breakeven in FY27.

segments.name: Loyalty loans / group business
segments.commentary: Loyalty loan yield 24.92%. Group referrals shifting from Muthoot Fincorp to Muthoot Microfin, with Muthoot Housing Finance and SIP contributing in small amounts.

segments.name: Co-lending
segments.commentary: Run down from INR940 crore to INR595 crore; management has stopped new co-lending and expects the book to reach near zero by year-end. Earlier co-lending peaked at INR900-plus crore, roughly one-third of business.

guidance_outlook: FY27 disbursement target of close to INR3,000 crore.
AUM expected to cross INR4,000 crore in FY26 close to INR4,500 crore (management's stated view); INR10,000 crore AUM targeted by FY28-FY29.
Cost-to-income about 85% now; management expects 70-75% for FY27 overall, against an earlier 60:40 goal.
Pre-tax ROA target of 2.0%-2.5% for MCSL; no explicit dividend commitment.

Equity raise targeted at around INR400 crore (INR200 crore upfront, INR200 crore milestone-linked CCPS), with term sheets expected and closing in the next 2-3 months; promoter holding 63.33%, wants to stay above 51%.
Planned new borrowings of about INR3,000 crore, where a further INR0.60 cost-of-funds reduction is expected to help.
Investor Day in Kochi or Mumbai to be arranged after an investor request.
risks_watch: GNPA at 6.96% (interest accrual) and 6.41% (principal); further rises in the 90+ bucket, plus the Up Money recovery.
Provision coverage about 50% with net NPA above 4%; provision reversals in Q4 supported PAT.
Cost-to-income at about 85%; FY27 target of 70-75% depends on impairment staying low and cost of funds falling 60 bps.
Equity raise of INR400 crore (CCPS, milestone-linked) is not yet confirmed; investor due diligence is pending.
Disbursement growth flat; FY27 target of about INR3,000 crore needs to be checked against quarterly run-rate.
Management noted macro uncertainty from the West Asia conflict, crude prices and liquidity, and said it will review the outlook quarter by quarter.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategy and the Board, but defensive on profitability and asset quality, repeatedly reframing the GNPA and ROA numbers. Management gave few hard numbers on FY27 profit and deflected dividend and leadership questions.

qa_highlights.question: Individual investor asked why there is no dividend or capital appreciation for equity holders and what profitability to expect for FY27.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said AUM grew from about INR2,000 crore to INR3,500 crore and cited higher opex from new verticals and digital spend; CFO said FY26 impairment was INR76 crore versus INR18-18.5 crore in FY25, and gave no FY27 profit number, only a pre-tax ROA target of 2.0-2.5%.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked if the board would consider new leadership given five to six quarters of weak performance and net NPA above 4% with about 50% PCR.
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said the co-lending pool with zero NPA is running off, so the own book looks worse by comparison; CFO said ex-Up Money GNPA was 5.64% versus 6.45% in Q3 and retail NNPA was 2.82%; board and promoters remain confident.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst said NPAs will cross 7% and disbursements have not grown QoQ or YoY while the auto sector is booming.
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the 6.96% figure includes the Up Money INR15.5 crore corporate NPA and the apples-to-apples GNPA is 5.64%; CEO said MCSL-own book grew 29% and co-lending degrowth of about 40% explains the flat total.

qa_highlights.question: What ROA and growth targets has management set internally for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the pre-tax ROA for MCSL is about 2-2.5%, and used car and CV are expected to break even in FY27 but are not included in the ROA calculation.

qa_highlights.question: How far is the INR10,000 crore AUM target and is the business model confident in North?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said the company is confident in INR10,000 crore by FY28-FY29 and expects AUM above INR4,000 crore, close to INR4,500 crore, by year-end FY26 (FY27 in context); growth will be calibrated and new markets are Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.

qa_highlights.question: What cost-to-income ratio to expect in FY27 and FY28, and how much equity will be raised?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said cost-to-income is about 85% now and FY27 is expected at about 70-75% versus the earlier 60:40 goal; equity raise targeted at about INR400 crore (INR200 crore upfront, INR200 crore milestone-linked CCPS), not yet confirmed, with term sheets to be awaited and closing in 2-3 months.

capex_capacity: Bank borrowing sanctions in FY26 were INR865 crore versus INR435 crore in the prior year; management plans about INR3,000 crore of new borrowings in FY27.
Fixed deposit book closed at INR80.83 crore at an 8.83% cost, up from about INR40-45 crore at the start of the year; online FD sourcing being started.
Used car AUM rose to INR155 crore from INR86 crore; CV AUM rose to about INR240 crore from INR61.25 crore; both expected to break even in FY27 but not included in overall ROA targets.
Management plans to expand in Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu and to deepen presence in North in a calibrated manner; no new geographies this year.

Operations automation: 2-wheeler credit scorecard-automated, operations STP at about 65% targeted to 90% in 2-3 months, cutting the 2-wheeler credit team from about 30 to 3-4 and operations from about 40-45 to about 5; KYC moving fully digital from May 2026.
demand_pricing: FY27 disbursement target of close to INR3,000 crore; management said the company is not adding co-lending and growth is only in MCSL-own book.
MCSL-own AUM rose 29% to INR2,758 crore from INR2,118 crore; co-lending fell about 37% to INR595 crore from INR940 crore and is expected to reach near zero by year-end.
Blended MCSL yield 21.02% versus about 18-18.5% at start of year; 2-wheeler 22.02%, used car 18.45%, CV 7.31%, loyalty loan 24.92%.
Cost of funds fell to 9.48% in Q4 from 10.09% in Q3; management cites a total reduction of INR0.60 over the year, with a further INR0.60 reduction expected to help on new INR3,000 crore borrowings.

Group business: Muthoot Microfin now referring loans alongside Muthoot Fincorp; Muthoot Housing Finance and SIP contribute in small amounts. Management said disbursement growth is not large and it is growing only MCSL-own book.
Management cites macro risks from West Asia conflict, crude prices and liquidity; said it is reviewing outlook quarter by quarter and sees no challenge as of now.

adds.what: Operations automation: 2-wheeler credit scorecard-automated, operations STP ~65% targeted to 90% (not physical capacity; headcount cut)

growth.why: Management targets close to INR3,000 crore FY27 disbursements (vs own AUM up 29% to INR2,758 crore), backed by a ~INR3,000 crore borrowing plan and a 2-wheeler/CV/used-car mix, but no quantified capacity additions and the brief gives no disbursement growth rate versus FY26.
